$comment: What this repository took from the factory, and when. /update-agents reads the version here, compares it against the factory release you name, and proposes the difference as a pull request. The roles in .claude/agents/, the skills in .claude/skills/, and the commands in .claude/commands/ are the real thing; this is the record of where they came from. One field is read at run time: `labels` is the vocabulary this release's preflight matches on, and the session-start hook compares it against the labels the repository actually has - because only `bootstrap` creates a label, and only a person can run `bootstrap`.
